paper.title_en: Stationary Rotating Geometries Associated with Nonsingular Pulsating Collapse
paper.abstract_en: Since the first exact solutions of General Relativity (GR) were obtained, it became clear that the theory predicts a new class of compact objects: black holes. The Hawking--Penrose singularity theorems show that, under appropriate assumptions, gravitational collapse in GR leads to singular behavior. Motivated by the expectation that such regimes require physics beyond classical GR, effective approaches inspired by Loop Quantum Cosmology (LQC) and braneworld scenarios introduce high-density corrections. In this work we consider the static exterior geometry introduced by Gao, Lu, Shen, and Faraoni, associated with a comoving interior model in which the singularity is avoided through a sequence of collapse and bounce phases. Using the Newman--Janis algorithm in the Azreg-Aïnou formulation, we construct a stationary rotating exterior extension of this geometry. The resulting line element describes a stationary axisymmetric rotating spacetime whose horizon geometry, angular velocity, surface gravity, and Hawking temperature recover the Kerr and Schwarzschild limits when the quantum/braneworld correction becomes negligible ($l\to 0$). We further analyze the thermal response at fixed rotational state-space parameter, identify Davies-type singular points, and formulate an extended thermodynamic state-space relation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文构建了非奇异脉动坍缩的静态外部几何的旋转推广，并分析了其热力学性质，与黑洞热力学和广义相对论基础相关。
decision.title_zh: 与非奇异脉动坍缩相关的稳态旋转几何
decision.abstract_zh: 自从广义相对论（GR）的第一批精确解被获得以来，人们就清楚地认识到该理论预言了一类新的致密天体：黑洞。霍金-彭罗斯奇点定理表明，在适当的假设下，引力坍缩在GR中会导致奇异行为。基于对这些情形需要超越经典GR的物理的预期，受环量子宇宙学（LQC）和膜世界方案启发的有效方法引入了高密度修正。在这项工作中，我们考虑由高、吕、沈和法拉奥尼引入的静态外部几何，它与一个共同移动的内部模型相关联，在该模型中，奇点通过一系列坍缩和反弹阶段得以避免。使用Azreg-Aïnou公式中的Newman-Janis算法，我们构造了该几何的稳态旋转外部延拓。得到的线元描述了一个稳态轴对称旋转时空，当量子/膜世界修正变得可忽略（$l\to 0$）时，其视界几何、角速度、表面引力和霍金温度恢复了克尔和史瓦西极限。我们进一步分析了在固定旋转态空间参数下的热响应，识别了戴维斯型奇点，并提出了一个扩展的热力学态空间关系。
